place.quota: This project has reached its size limit. Remove something before adding more.
place.unknownDefinition: That part is not in the library, so it was not placed.
place.boardView: The Board tab shows the board on its own. Parts go on the Breadboard or Schematic tab.
place.readOnly: This project is open read only, so parts cannot be added.
place.placedLoose: Placed {refdes} on the canvas. Drag it onto the breadboard to seat it, or wire its pins.
place.placedLooseChip: Placed {refdes} on the canvas. A chip seats across the centre channel of the breadboard: drag it there with pin 1 on the lower side of the channel, or wire its pins.
place.armed: {name} is ready. Tap the canvas to place it.
place.zoomed: Zoomed in. Tap again to place it.

seat.unseated: {refdes} is off the breadboard, so its legs are no longer connected.
seat.rotateBlocked: {refdes} did not turn: the turned legs would not land on free holes. Move it first, or free the holes it needs.

palette.title: Parts
palette.emptyHelp: Try a shorter word, or a kind such as passive or display.
palette.armed: {name} is ready. Click or tap to place it: over the breadboard it snaps into the holes. Press Enter to place it in the middle of the view.
